'''''One Thousand, One Hundred and Thirty-Eight Wonders of the Ancient Galaxy''''' was a book written by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ualp Xathan]]. It was published on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beshka]] by [[TriPlanetary Press/Legends|TriPlanetary Press]] in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it was still considered a reference, and the young [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] once consulted it while redacting an [[Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break|essay]] for her [[Droid/Legends|droid]] tutor [[DV-9]]. The bibliographic reference for that edition was properly written as: "Xathan, Ualp. ''One Thousand, One Hundred and Thirty-Eight Wonders of the Ancient Galaxy.'' Beshka: TriPlanetary Press, 25 (GrS)."<ref name="SPL" />

==Behind the scenes==
''One Thousand, One Hundred and Thirty-Eight Wonders of the Ancient Galaxy'' was introduced in the [[Star Wars (1977) 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of the [[1977]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] by [[Marvel Comics]].<ref name="SW84">[[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]]</ref>
